newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB says no comment on Westpac shares.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB says no comment on Westpac shares.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Wednesday it had no Comment on media and market speculation that it had bought a large number of Westpac Banking Corp converting preference shares.
"We don't make any comments on rumours in the market place at all," NAB spokesman Haydn Park told Reuters.

The purchases had also pushed Westpac's ordinary shares sharply higher, with speculation that NAB or an international bank was building a strategic stake ahead of a full bid to be launched after the government's banking inquiry hands down its report in March 1997.
Westpac shares were five cents higher at A$6.81 at 2.10 p.m. (0410 GMT).
